RESEARCH

Research.

I am interested in geometric group theory and low-dimensional topology, especially the ways that finite quotients reflect the structure of infinite groups.

RESEARCH INTERESTS

My work centers on profinite completions of mapping class groups and Artin groups, and on questions of rigidity, subgroup structure, and the relationship between geometric and algebraic invariants.
